heading: What a well-planned migration can improve
intro: The benefits depend on your starting environment and the decisions made during the move. We review these areas against your requirements with your team.

items.title: Cost visibility
items.description: Connect resource choices and usage to operating costs, including the cost of maintaining the new environment.

items.title: Scalability
items.description: Choose capacity and scaling options that can respond to demand without relying only on hardware purchases.

items.title: Security
items.description: Make access, network boundaries, patching responsibilities, and recovery procedures explicit and reviewable.

items.title: Speed of change
items.description: Use repeatable environment setup and clearer operating documentation to make infrastructure changes easier to manage.
